== Overview ==

Global map with custom expansions, custom client, mechanics & items, QoL systems. No Bots or macros. PvP, No Pay to Win, 1x rates. Long term Alternative Open Tibia 7.4 OT server free to play. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
